name: Die window
description: A silicon die reduced to four rounded facets and one open core. The generous counter gives it a precise, compact signature.

name: Parallel
description: Three compute lanes share a rounded crest. Broad curves and cropped ends soften the precision of parallel processing.

name: Facet
description: Three crystal planes meet around a triangular opening. A solid, low-detail mark drawn from silicon as a material.

name: Relay
description: A continuous route folds around an open corner. The offset terminal gives this direction movement without an arrow or a letter.

name: Impeller
description: Five broad cooling blades sweep around a clear centre. Hardware appears in the geometry rather than as a drawing of a GPU.

name: Wafer pair
description: Two clipped wafer sections fit around a diagonal channel. Broad surfaces and a large counter keep the mark calm at small sizes.

name: Clearing
description: Two matching sides meet at an open settlement window. Its horizontal silhouette can sit comfortably beside a wordmark later.

name: Lattice
description: Four linked cells make a single open lattice. The broad diamond tiles reference a chip layout with no pins or circuit-board ornament.

name: Fin
description: A tapered set of cooling fins. The angled edge and different lengths give it a more editorial, distinctive profile.

name: Phase
description: Two broad loops share a centre. The paired movement suggests two sides of a market, while the four openings keep the form light.

name: Fold
description: A folded plane wraps an open triangular core. One clipped corner keeps this direction off-centre and gives the silhouette a physical character.

name: Channel
description: Two rising channels form a stepped crest. The offset connection gives this one a softer rhythm while keeping the silhouette technical.

name: Bond
description: Four soft crystal lobes surround a square of air. The outward curves and flat inner edges make an organic, quietly technical symbol.

name: Socket
description: An open socket wraps around a floating core. The two levels create a recognisable silhouette from a minimal hardware reference.

name: Hour
description: Two opposing curves narrow around a central pause. A compact reference to GPU rental time and settlement periods.

name: Flux
description: A broad current curls around an open centre, followed by a smaller plane. A softer way to suggest moving capacity and market flow.

name: Register
description: A compact array of six compute tiles. Rounded outside corners and wide internal spacing hint at memory modules and chip packaging.

name: Seed
description: A small core held inside a split crystal shell. This is the softest direction, with a compact vertical footprint and simple internal space.

name: Vector
description: A beveled plane breaks away from its origin. The stepped edge hints at a compute tile, with a deliberately directional silhouette.

name: Torus
description: A rounded triangular loop encloses one generous opening. Broad, soft edges give the symbol a dreamlike quality with no material effects.
